text:
maria: Heads-up — terraform change to prod-gpu VPC egress rules is queued. Intention: deny all outbound by default and switch to an allowlist for telemetry/storage endpoints. This will trigger Conftest/OPA in the gitops pipeline. Need approvals and a canary plan.

tj: Can you paste the terraform diff or the values change?

maria: Sure — simplified snippet from the PR: 
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "egress_default" {
  from_port   = 0
  to_port     = 0
  protocol    = "-1"
  cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"]
}
# -> replacing with explicit allowlist blocks
```
And Helm values to carry: 
```yaml
network:
  egress:
    allowlist:
      - s3.amazonaws.com
      - monitoring.redwood.ai
```

infra-bot: Conftest/OPA check failed for branch feature/network-egress: 
```bash
conftest test -p policies/ network/egress.tf
FAIL - network/egress.tf - no-egress-allowlist: egress must not allow 0.0.0.0/0
```

alex: Per our current freeze window we need infra + security signoff for any policy exemptions. Also note: routing logs to eu-bucket from us-west will incur cross-region egress costs — include cost estimate in PR.

sam: Suggestion: create a dedicated canary GPU pool (tag: canary=egress-test) and limit to 2 nodes. Roll helm chart with changed values only against that pool first.

ben: SRE-oncall here — if egress is closed we could lose telemetry and tracing. Add a fallback relay (in-region) for metrics and a queued delivery for logs so we don't drop data. I'll prepare alert thresholds.

maria: Good call. Also Conftest will block the gitops merge. Options: (1) request a short-lived OPA exemption with explicit reviewers, (2) update policy to allow documented allowlist pattern, or (3) adjust PR to be purely canary-targeted so it doesn't affect main clusters.

tj: For (1) infra-lead + security lead can approve an exemption. We can attach a TTL tag to the exemption. But we should avoid exemptions that last longer than 24h.

alex: +1 from infra for canary approach, but require rollback playbook and dashboard. Document these metrics: telemetry success rate, logs delivered/s, pod egress denied count, and GPU job failures.

sam: I'll open a helm release PR with these values and a nodeSelector: 
```bash
helm upgrade --install model-service ./charts/model --namespace prod-canary \
  --set network.egress.allowlist=["monitoring.redwood.ai"] \
  --set replicaCount=2 \
  --set nodeSelector.gpu="true" \
  --set releaseMetadata.tag="canary-egress-2026-03-18"\
```

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline started for prod-canary (build 4521) — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4521

sre-oncall: I'll watch telemetry. Setting temporary alert: telemetry.error_rate > 3% for 5m -> page SRE oncall. Also alert for egress_denied_rate > 0.5% across prod-gpu for 5m.

maria: I'll add PR description with cost delta estimate and a short rollback playbook (kubectl rollback + tag removal). Will also add request for security review (cc @security). If we don't get objection by EOD PST, we proceed with canary tonight.

alex: Sounds good. One ask: include a test that sends synthetic traces/logs to the allowlist endpoints and validates delivery before promoting.

ben: I'll run the synthetic tests once the canary is up and post results here.

maria: Thanks all — creating the gitops PR now and adding the Conftest failure logs + exemption path (if needed). Will ping when PR is up.

tj: ack, will review the PR and the exemption flow if you need a quick sign-off.

maria: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/ops-gitops/pulls/789 — includes canary-only helm values, cost note, and rollback steps. Please review.

infra-bot: Conftest re-run on PR 789: still failing because main policy blocks any change that would remove 0.0.0.0/0 without explicit allowlist. Exemption requested: EX-2026-129 by maria.

alex: I reviewed the PR and the rollback steps. +1 from infra. Security team, please advise on exemption EX-2026-129.

sre-oncall: Monitoring hooks in place. Will confirm synthetic test results within 30m of canary deploy.

maria: tagging this thread for visibility — cc @tj @alex @ben @sre-oncall. Thanks everyone.
